The supplied Linktree and the band's official website both identify @filthyanimalsband_official as the band's Instagram profile.
The official Filthy Animals website links directly to the Facebook profile and identifies its handle as @filthyanimalsoz.
The supplied artist-controlled Linktree's TikTok control resolves to the direct @filthy.animals.band profile.
The supplied Linktree links this domain as Website; the site identifies The Filthy Animals as an Australian party supergroup and describes its rotating lineup.
